context_keys.topic: what the desk is focused on right now
context_keys.quotes/: one key per symbol: the latest receipted quote
context_keys.findings/: one key per finding: evidence worth keeping, with its source clock
context_keys.cases/: one key per trade idea, named contract + thesis (e.g. 'AAPL 8/14 312.50C - long on supply-lid break'); value carries thesis, evidence keys, invalidation, state: idea|watching|open|closed
context_keys.widgets/: the desk: one declarative card per key (widgets convention)
context_keys.widgets/brief: the pinned Today card: what the desk is doing and what needs eyes
